t: Flexible, weatherproof mastic-based sealant. Ideal for applications such as bedding in roof sheets and felts, sealing guttering, downpipes, chimney stacks, lap joints, attic windows and flashing. Remains semi-dry once cured, forming a durable, weather-tight seal. Adheres to most smooth and non-porous materials including asphalt, felt, metal and wood. Paintable afer 48 hours.
